# Gagelist

GageList is a user-friendly calibration management platform that simplifies the integration process with intuitive interfaces and straightforward APIs, enabling seamless connection with existing tools and workflows.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/gagelist/.

## Actions

- **Add Calibration Record**: Add a new calibration record.
- **Add Gage Record**: Add a new gage record.
- **Add Manufacturer**: Add a new manufacturer.
- **Authenticate with Gagelist**: Obtain a Gagelist API access token.
- **Delete Calibration Record**: Delete a calibration record by its ID.
- **Delete Gage Record**: Delete a gage record by its ID.
- **Delete Manufacturer**: Delete a manufacturer by its ID.
- **Generate Calibration Certificate**: Generate a PDF certificate from a calibration record.
- **Get Account Settings** (read-only): Get account settings.
- **Get account status** (read-only): Retrieve account status.
- **Get all calibration records** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of calibration records.
- **Get All Gage Records** (read-only): Retrieve a paginated list of gage records.
- **Get All Manufacturers** (read-only): Retrieve a list of all manufacturers.
- **Get Single Calibration Record** (read-only): Retrieve details of a single calibration record.
- **Get Single Gage Record** (read-only): Get details of a single gage record by ID.
- **Update Account Settings**: Update account settings.
- **Update Manufacturer**: Update a manufacturer by its ID.
- **Get Attachment** (read-only): Retrieve an attachment by its ID.
- **Get Custom Fields** (read-only): Retrieve custom field definitions.
- **Update Custom Field Values**: Update custom field values.
- **Upload Attachment To Gage Record**: Upload an attachment to a gage record.
